name: Pitch & Distortion
description: Change pitch (without changing speed), distortion, reverb, echo and more on music. Works with Jukebox songs.

apply-in-levels.name: Apply in levels
apply-in-levels.description: Pitch no longer changes speed, so this is safe to leave on.

pitch-semitones.name: Pitch (semitones)
pitch-semitones.description: 0 is normal. Changes pitch only, not speed.

speed.name: Speed (menus only)
speed.description: Song speed without changing pitch. Ignored inside levels so the music stays in sync.

muffle.name: Muffle (low-pass)
muffle.description: Cuts high frequencies for an underwater or behind-a-wall sound.
